entries.meaning: Plant has 3 distinct senses.
examples: I killed every plant I owned until somebody gave me a pothos.
She waters the plants on Sunday mornings.
That plant needs a lot more light than it's getting.
The assembly plant employs two thousand people.
A power plant sits on the far side of the river.
The plant shuts down for two weeks every July.
The heckler turned out to be a plant.
Police used a plant inside the gang.
Half the audience suspected the volunteer was a plant.

senses.head: A living thing that grows in soil and usually has leaves and roots
examples: I killed every plant I owned until somebody gave me a pothos.
She waters the plants on Sunday mornings.
That plant needs a lot more light than it's getting.

senses.head: A factory or a building where power is produced or goods are made
examples: The assembly plant employs two thousand people.
A power plant sits on the far side of the river.
The plant shuts down for two weeks every July.

senses.head: A person secretly placed in a group to spy on it or influence it
examples: The heckler turned out to be a plant.
Police used a plant inside the gang.
Half the audience suspected the volunteer was a plant.

entries.meaning: Tree has 2 distinct senses.

They planted two trees the year their daughter was born.
The storm knocked a tree down across the road.

senses.head: A diagram that branches out to show how things are connected
examples: She traced the family tree back to 1820.

entries.meaning: The colored part of a plant that produces seeds. ---
examples: He brought her flowers for no particular reason.
That flower only opens at night.

entries.meaning: Branch has 2 distinct senses.

entries.meaning: One of the colored parts that make up a flower. ---

senses.head: A foolish person who is easy to fool, in informal speech

entries.meaning: A tree or bush that keeps its leaves or needles all year. ---

entries.meaning: A machine for cutting grass. ---
